This plot na only small piece, less than quarter of my farm. I dey plant yam and small cassava here, the way my father taught me. I no get plenty money this season, so I go use the manure from my goats and small chicken droppings — that one no cost me anything. Fertilizer bag dey too expensive for this small land, and one full bag go waste here. I go use the yam setts from last year harvest, the ones wey give me good tubers, and me and my wife go do most of the work ourselves. If weeds too much during second weeding, I fit call one or two young men from the village to help for one or two days.
